description: Location: UAE-based (Travel required) Duration: 6-month assignment Summary (Data Engineer) Timely, reliable data pipelines are what turn a platform design into business value. The Data Engineer builds and operates the pipelines that move data from source systems into the lakehouse and on to analytics and AI consumers, ensuring that the pipelines are automated, performant, secure and governed. The role works alongside the data architect, data quality engineer, business analysts and AI engineers, delivering production-grade pipelines on Azure / Microsoft Fabric, with metadata and lineage captured in Microsoft Purview. Implement dimensional models, SCDs, surrogate keys and data marts according to the architect's designs. Integrate DQ checks, validation, quarantine and reconciliation into pipelines in partnership with the Senior Data Quality Engineer. Ensure that pipelines publish metadata and lineage to Microsoft Purview. Implement scheduling, dependency management, parameterization, error handling and alerting. Apply access controls, masking, encryption and secure credential management in line with UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR. Maintain code in source control and deploy through CI/CD pipelines, with automated tests and environment promotion. Support production operations, incident resolution and runbooks, and coach counterparts so that the pipelines can be sustained after handover. Must Have 4+ years in data engineering, preferably within UAE government or regulated-sector environments. Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark/Spark skills. Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Synapse. Strong understanding of Lakehouse/Medallion architecture, Delta/Parquet formats and dimensional modelling, including SCDs and surrogate keys. Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub), source control and DataOps practices. Familiarity with Microsoft Purview metadata and lineage, and with DQ tooling. Awareness of UAE data regulation, including UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR. Excellent English communication and documentation skills. title: Software Development Engineer - Agentic Data Infrastructure, Partner Data And Analytics
description: DESCRIPTION The Data Services team within PDNA (Partner Data And Analytics) builds and operates the Agentic Data Platform that powers Amazon's Selling Partner analytics infrastructure. We serve 900K+ Selling Partners and 30K+ Amazonians through 4,000+ standardized metrics, real-time streaming pipelines validated at Black Friday scale (142M+ events), and the Curated Data Layer (CDL) — Amazon's strategic data infrastructure for Selling Partner GenAI applications including Seller Assistant, Supply Chain Expert, MCF, and ISS. We are building the future where intelligent agents autonomously operate data pipelines, serve analytics through MCP servers, and enable self-service insights at scale. You will build the infrastructure layer that sits between raw data and intelligent agents. Think of it as the operating system for agentic data — the MCP servers agents call, the query engines they reason through, the schema contracts they interpret, the streaming backbone they react to, and the validation services they trust. This is systems engineering applied to the agentic AI problem: you are not building agents — you are building the infrastructure that makes agents possible. Key job responsibilities 1) Design and build MCP servers and data access APIs 2) Engineer the real-time streaming backbone using Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka/MSK, Kinesis, and Lambda that powers agentic workflows. 3) Build agent orchestration infrastructure — the tool registries, execution planners, state stores, and handoff protocols that enable specialized agents (ingestion, validation, delivery) to coordinate across the data operations lifecycle. 4) Develop trust and validation infrastructure that keeps agent-generated outputs reliable 5) Extend the lakehouse for agentic consumption — building metadata contracts, schema registries, and catalog APIs on top of our Iceberg-based infrastructure that agents can reason over autonomously. 6) Own your systems end-to-end — design, build, test, deploy, operate, and document. Your infrastructure will be observable, self-healing, and resilient. You will participate in on-call, drive root-cause analysis, and permanently resolve operational issues. 7) BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, Lucene/SOLR or Storm/Samza experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience Proficiency in one or more systems languages (Java, Python, Kotlin, TypeScript, Scala, or Rust) Experience designing and operating production services — API design, distributed system patterns (consistency, partitioning, fault tolerance), and service-oriented architectures Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and system design Experience with data infrastructure — lakehouse architectures (Iceberg), query engines (Athena, Trino), or metadata/catalog systems PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with agentic AI infrastructure — tool registries, agent orchestration, LLM integration, or agent state management Familiarity with GenAI infrastructure patterns (RAG, embedding stores, evaluation frameworks) Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
